expressibility.reason: The native configuration has no > comparison, so choice cannot be transcribed verbatim. The extra gtz definition and its call replace m>0 by m in {1,...,16}; its body is C under rule 6 and its definition/call are R under rule 10. Starting with n=8,12,16, every recursive m is in 0..n, so this preserves the entire choice relation on every sequence at the stated sizes, not merely the accepted answers. The head equations, L/R disjunction, decrement, recursion, accept facts and query order are transcriptions. No supporting mechanism is needed. The finite guard is not a general positive-integer comparison for n>16; hidden variants were not available or read, so no claim that those pass is made. Systems/absys Notation and SPECIFICATION expressibility; METRICS rules 3,6,8,10; AMENDMENTS 3.4.
